text_block_list.text: While heading to the trainer's office...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
A big carrot plus ice cream makes... the 
present continuous tense...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe... My... makeup class... just 
finished...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Um, you see... I couldn't remember the 
grammar rules, so I decided to... memorize 
them using food...!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
A big carrot is the 'be' verb, and ice 
cream is... umm...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ice cream is... I really... love carrot 
ice cream...

Unable to memorize the grammar, Haru Urara 
had to take supplementary lessons for her 
supplementary lessons, and ended up making 
herself sick.
